name: reasoning
title: Reasoning
description: The model's thinking, folded away. Open while it thinks, closed when the answer starts.

props.name: children
props.description: The model's reasoning so far. Plain text or your own markup.

props.name: streaming
props.description: True while the model is still thinking.

props.name: ms
props.description: How long the thinking took, in milliseconds. Shown once it is done.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start open. By default it is open while streaming and closes when done.

a11y.text: The header is a native button, so Tab, Enter and Space toggle it. Once the reader has toggled it, their choice stands, even when streaming changes.

The button sets aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing at the content, which is hidden while closed. Its label reads Thinking while streaming, Thought for N seconds when ms is given, otherwise Reasoning. The icons are aria-hidden.
Under reduced motion the pulsing brain icon, the chevron turn and the fade-in of the opened content are off.
